headline: Pace and Southern New Hampshire enter conference play unbeaten
dek: Both have four wins and two draws from six matches, and have got there by different routes: Southern New Hampshire have scored twenty-four goals to Pace's eleven, while only four have gone past Pace. The home side is still unbeaten in the four meetings between members, three won and one drawn.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's twenty-four goals are spread across at least thirteen scorers, so no single player carries the tallest bar; Pace sit mid-chart on eleven, and the four they have conceded is the smaller figure that explains their unbeaten record.

wire.line: Two sides go into conference play unbeaten, and Southern Connecticut go in without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern New Hampshire conceded four goals at Bridgeport, more than they had conceded in their first five matches together.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Assumption's draw with Bentley is the first of the four meetings between members that the home side has not won.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern Connecticut remain the only programme without a win, with two draws and two defeats from four matches after losing at home to Mercy.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cody Holbert has scored eight goals from twenty-nine shots, more goals than any other player listed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Joe Zweben has made twenty-eight saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

last_match.line: Southern New Hampshire remain unbeaten but conceded more here than in the whole season before it; Bridgeport had already drawn at American International and won at Franklin Pierce.

next_match.line: Conference play opens with Southern Connecticut still looking for a first win; Franklin Pierce arrive on back-to-back wins, including the heaviest of the meetings between members so far.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
